selection: Complete current bounded source/config/document texts and small two-day evidence, workspace plan/daily/finance/audits, fresh deployed source overlay; not a delta snapshot.
limitations: Weights/datasets/full raw runs/videos remain external verified backups.

Archive excludes final-source-freeze.json and itself to avoid hash cycles.
